name: accesslint
description: Accessibility linter for PRs using axe-core and browser automation

scripts.preview: node -e "const { exec } = require('child_process'); const p = 'tests/demo-preview.html'; const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? `start ${p}` : process.platform === 'darwin' ? `open ${p}` : `xdg-open ${p}`; exec(cmd, () => console.log('Opened ' + p));"
